libs.note: BH-5946. Three optional modules of bin/blocked-resolver.sh read these: bin/lib/br/opt/profile.sh (the run's `prof:` line and its per-row TSV), bin/lib/br/opt/readmemo.sh (the per-run read memo) and bin/lib/br/opt/unchanged.sh (the unchanged-row skip). Each module calls lib_env_apply br-repeat-cuts when it is sourced, so a settings row wins over the env and the default here is the fallback. BR_OPT_OFF=profile,readmemo,unchanged turns any of them off as well.

knobs.note: 1: every run with candidates writes one `prof:` line after its `tick:` line (stage seconds, GitHub calls by endpoint shape, D1 calls, model calls, memo hits, unchanged skips, the 5 slowest rows) and one TSV row per dispatched candidate in state/blocked-resolver/profile/. 0: neither. flags/br-profile-off is the same as 0.
How many per-run TSV files state/blocked-resolver/profile/ keeps; the oldest go in the same run. 24 is 4 h of */10 runs.

1: a repeat GET of a PR, an issue, its comment pages or the merged-PR search in one run is answered from a file memo of that run. A rung always reads live. 0: every read goes to GitHub. flags/br-readmemo-off is the same as 0.
The oldest memo entry a read may use, the same bound as BR_PRS_CACHE_SECS. An older entry is read again. 0 turns the memo off.

The longest time a row that ended on a quiet exit is skipped while its local inputs (the conductor row, the state record, the build record, the queue files) do not change. This is also the latest a hold lift (a RESUME comment), a person's answer on a needs-human hold or a newer job row for an abandoned ticket is seen. 0 (or flags/br-unchanged-off) skips nothing.

knobs.default: held escalated stalled job-abandoned hv-stands rung-hold needs-human ci-parked
knobs.note: The quiet exits a row may be skipped after, a space list. Remove a class to look at its rows on every run.
